## Part 2 practical {#part-2-practicals}

After the descriptive slides, run the companion R notebook with your instructor.
It brings together all 18 R examples from the slides, with their original code
and comments, introductions and guidance for reading the results. It uses the
same supplied student dataset; the Excel examples remain in the slides.

Part 3 preserves the original probability, estimation, hypothesis-testing and regression
slides, including the original Excel examples and labeled R equivalents. Business
applications are kept separately in the practicals and extended cases.

| Practical | Read online | Download |
|---|---|---|
| Descriptive Statistics — R Practical | [Open practical](practicals/descriptive-statistics-r-practical.html) | [PDF](pdf/descriptive-statistics-r-practical.pdf) |

## Extended Business Cases {#extended-business-cases}

- Apply the course methods to another business setting after the core practicals or the relevant Part 3 topics.
- Each case stays together as one notebook, with a worked analysis and independent business tasks.
- Your instructor may assign selected cases or sections; the extended cases are optional.
- ANOVA, forecasting and process control include introductions and are marked as extensions.

| Extended case | Start after / focus | Read online | Download |
|---|---|---|---|
| Superstore — three notebooks | Part 2: categorical data, numerical measures, association and groups | [Open case](extended-cases/superstore/index.qmd) | PDFs: [1](pdf/practical-01-categorical-business-data.pdf), [2](pdf/practical-02-numerical-business-data.pdf), [3](pdf/practical-03-association-and-groups.pdf) |
| 1. Springville Herald | Part 2: daily calls; Part 3: regression; optional forecasting | [Open case](extended-cases/case-01-springville-herald.qmd) | [PDF](pdf/case-01-springville-herald.pdf) |
| 2. Oxford Cereal | Part 3: sampling, estimation and one-mean testing | [Open case](extended-cases/case-02-oxford-cereal.qmd) | [PDF](pdf/case-02-oxford-cereal.pdf) |
| 3. BLK Retail Display | Part 3: independent-group comparisons applied to COLA | [Open case](extended-cases/case-03-retail-display.qmd) | [PDF](pdf/case-03-retail-display.pdf) |
| 4. Perfect Parachute | Part 3: extend two-group comparisons to ANOVA | [Open case](extended-cases/case-04-perfect-parachute.qmd) | [PDF](pdf/case-04-perfect-parachute.pdf) |
| 5. Mountain States Potato | Part 3: multiple regression and diagnostics | [Open case](extended-cases/case-05-mountain-states-potato.qmd) | [PDF](pdf/case-05-mountain-states-potato.pdf) |
| 6. Harnswell Quality | After Parts 2–3: optional process-control extension | [Open case](extended-cases/case-06-harnswell-quality.qmd) | [PDF](pdf/case-06-harnswell-quality.pdf) |

The six numbered cases draw on Berenson, Levine and Krehbiel's *Basic Business Statistics: Concepts and Applications*, ninth edition. Each identifies its source, observational unit and limits; Oxford uses reported summary inputs rather than raw box weights.

## Work with R or study offline

- [Download the complete student RStudio project](downloads/applied-statistics-rstudio.zip): editable lessons, the descriptive R practical, Superstore and six further extended cases, teaching CSVs, shared styling and setup instructions. Extract the ZIP, then open `Applied-Statistics.Rproj` in RStudio.
- [Download all 16 lesson, practical and extended-case PDFs](downloads/applied-statistics-pdfs.zip).

The online lessons and PDFs show the code and its results. To run or change R code, use the RStudio project.
